name: UGC 3816 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 3816, a compact elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc3816-hubble
story: A small galaxy whose stars swarm at extreme speeds, a hint that an outsized black hole may sit at its center. Hubble imaged its compact core to help weigh that black hole.

claims.text: UGC 3816 is a compact elliptical galaxy discovered by the Hobby-Eberly Telescope Massive Galaxy Survey
UGC3816 is a target of Hubble program 13050, imaging small galaxies with extremely high velocity dispersions and suspected monster black holes
